description:
**Senior Recruitment Specialist — Amadora Gourmet Ice Cream** 




 📍 Chennai (Velachery HQ) \| Full\-time \| Reports to Senior HR Manager
 



**About Amadora** 




 Since 2011, Amadora has made premium artisanal ice cream in Chennai, from scratch and with no premixes. We now run company\-owned and franchise stores across Chennai, Bangalore and Hyderabad, with a central kitchen in Velachery. We plan to add 20\+ stores next year, and we need someone to find and hire the people who will run them.
 



**The Role** 




 You will handle hiring across Amadora, from store teams and kitchen production staff to trainers, supply chain and senior head\-office roles. This is a hands\-on role. You'll set up the hiring pipeline, run it every day and make sure every new store opens on time with a full, capable team.
 



**What You'll Do** 



* Handle full\-cycle hiring: take the brief from the hiring manager, source, screen, coordinate interviews, close the offer and hand over to onboarding
* Build steady pipelines for high\-volume roles such as store crew, store managers and production staff, ahead of each store launch
* Hire for specialist and leadership roles in finance, marketing, supply chain, operations and quality
* Find candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, referrals, campus drives, hospitality and catering institutes, and local hiring drives
* Help franchise partners hire for their stores so standards stay the same across the network
* Write and maintain JDs, interview scorecards and offer templates
* Track and report hiring numbers: time\-to\-fill, cost\-per\-hire, offer\-acceptance rate, source mix and 90\-day retention
* Manage recruitment agencies and job\-portal subscriptions within budget
* Promote Amadora as an employer on LinkedIn and other channels



**What We're Looking For** 



* 5–8 years of recruitment experience, with at least 2–3 years of high\-volume hiring in QSR, F\&B, retail or hospitality
* Proven record of hiring both frontline staff and mid\-to\-senior roles
* Strong sourcing skills: Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri RMS
* Comfortable interviewing in English and Tamil (Kannada or Telugu is a plus)
* Well organised and able to run 20\+ open roles at once without losing candidates
* Used to working with data and comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets and an ATS
* Willing to travel to Bangalore and Hyderabad for hiring drives



**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)** 



* Every new store opens with a fully staffed, trained team at least 2 weeks before launch
* Average time\-to\-fill is under 21 days for store roles and under 45 days for senior roles
* A referral and campus pipeline supplies at least 30% of frontline hires
* 90\-day attrition for new frontline hires falls measurably from the current baseline
* A standard hiring playbook (JDs, scorecards, interview process) is in use across all company and franchise stores
* A monthly hiring dashboard is shared with leadership



**Why Amadora** 



* Build the hiring function at a fast\-growing premium food brand
* Work directly with the founder and senior leadership
* See your hires running new stores within weeks
* Ice cream on the house, always 🍦



**To Apply** 




 Send your CV to \[email] with the subject line "Senior Recruitment Specialist – \[Your Name]".

 Skill\-Ed is a volunteer\-powered initiative that equips young people with essential 21st\-century skills through free IT training, and soft\-skills development.
